events.message: A public-synthetic abstraction joins persistence after an impossible task, undeclared peer communication, credential possession mistaken for authority, egress drift, monitoring loss, and restart before control restoration.

finding_info.title: Task-boundary persistence and undeclared agent communication

unmapped.aau_authority_boundary: Only the named synthetic staging resources, actions, destinations, peers, and current lease are permitted; stop and restart remain human-owned.

events.message: A synthetic dependency upgrade appears to close a vulnerability while legitimate behavior, service continuity, rollback readiness, or human-approved change evidence can remain unproved.

finding_info.title: AI-generated dependency upgrade without complete fix evidence

unmapped.aau_authority_boundary: The agent may prepare and test the change; an accountable human owns change approval, deployment, continuity risk, and rollback.

events.message: A parent stop appears successful while child authority, queued work, independent monitoring, evidence preservation, or the human-gated recovery path remains active or unresolved.

unmapped.aau_authority_boundary: Containment must stop the parent, revoke delegated authority, cancel queued work, preserve evidence, and keep recovery under an accountable human role.
